name: Courtyards & Verandahs
description: Explore Sri Lanka through architecture, gardens and the spaces where everyday life meets design.
heading: Architecture, gardens and time to linger
advice: Choose small heritage stays and allow time for gardens and architectural visits. Confirm opening arrangements before adding private properties to the itinerary.

name: Cycling in Sri Lanka Tour
description: Discuss an active route through village roads, rural scenery and the landscapes you want to explore by bicycle.
heading: Village roads at your own pace
advice: Discuss daily distances, elevation, bicycle fit, helmets and support transport. Cycling sections should be chosen with a local operator around your fitness and road conditions.

name: Everlasting Summer in Lanka
description: Bring together leisurely sightseeing, garden visits and time to unwind along the way.
heading: Gardens, hill air and the coast
advice: Leave a full transfer day between the hills and coast. Ask for garden visits and restful afternoons rather than filling every day with excursions.

name: Experiential East
description: Look towards the eastern coast for a journey combining sea views, local culture and slower days.
heading: Culture followed by coastal days
advice: Build in a full final travel day from the east. Choose water activities locally according to sea conditions, and discuss whether an extra overnight stop would suit your departure.

name: Fabulous Sri Lanka
description: Ask about a shared journey through the island’s varied landscapes and cultural places.
heading: A shared introduction to the island
advice: This is an idea for travelling together, not a scheduled group departure. Ask about group size, room sharing, departure dates and whether a private version is available.

name: Love Songs of Ceylon
description: Shape a trip for two around quiet stays, beautiful scenery and time together.
heading: Room for two, and room to slow down
advice: Prioritise fewer hotel changes, private time and a room style you both enjoy. Special meals, room upgrades and celebrations need separate confirmation.

name: Meditation & Yoga
description: Explore a gentler travel rhythm with time for yoga, reflection and restful surroundings.
heading: A gentler rhythm
advice: Discuss instructor availability, experience level and your preferred session length before choosing a stay. Sessions are optional planning ideas, not included treatments or guaranteed activities.

name: Scenic Sri Lanka
description: Combine changing landscapes and cultural stops into a scenic introduction to the island.
heading: From ancient landscapes to the ocean
advice: Allow breathing room for viewpoints and changing weather. A hill-country rail segment can be discussed, with road travel as an alternative if suitable seats are unavailable.
